scope: Worker-run production-export tests using intercepted public RPC and synthetic EIP-6963 wallet. No real transactions.

results.name: Static subpath; live configuration and ABI; first-screen primary control; 320/390/1440 reflow
EIP-6963 discovery; generic row hidden; keyboard dialog close and focus return
Free post: simulation, explicit review, exact zero burn, no ETH value, receipt, cooldown
Unknown chain: switch, add exact handoff chain, switch again
Paid flow: six decimals; explicit approval then post; pending stays locked
Existing insufficient allowance: reset to zero before exact approval
Wallet rejection is recoverable and sends nothing
Simulation revert exposes useful error and never requests a signature
Minimum increases after review: no silent increase and no wallet write
Owner setup validates address, requires acknowledgement, and sets token once
Phone wallet links retain subpath; Coinbase Smart Wallet; no relay
50 message history; long balances and Unicode; no HTML injection; no horizontal overflow
Read failure retains state, disables posting, and recovers on refresh
No browser wallet gives an actionable error; connection rejection can retry
Pending transaction survives reload and blocks another submission until status check
ABI tampering fails closed before wallet or transaction controls load
Text enlargement, RTL layout, reduced motion, and modal focus trap
